title: Rig IDE Capability Manifest
description: Canonical, single-source-of-truth capability registry for IDE bridges. Used to generate both the Python sidecar permission table and the TypeScript capability broker. All registries MUST be validated against this manifest — drift between TypeScript and Python implementations is a validation failure.

plane.description: Which subsystem owns this capability: ide=editor APIs, ui=user interface actions, core=rig-internal

risk.description: Risk level for user approval and auditing

mutates.description: Whether this capability can mutate workspace state. 'possible' means it depends on context.

default_policy.description: Default approval policy. allow=no prompt, ask=prompt user, deny=blocked

requires_workspace_trust.description: If true, this capability only works in trusted workspaces (VS Code Workspace Trust)

receipt_kind.description: Receipt schema kind for this capability execution

implemented_in.description: Which IDE platforms have implemented this capability

description.description: Human-readable description of what this capability does
